questions.text: How does sociology help in understanding society in daily life?
questions.text_as_printed: How does sociology help in understanding society in daily life? (A)

answer.value: Although general knowledge often helps us in our day-to-day life, it sometimes fails to answer certain important questions. In such situations, social science helps us. For example, by studying women, it can scientifically prove that they are as capable and equal as men.

questions.text: Explain role consciousness with an example.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain role consciousness with an example. (A)

answer.value:
Role Consciousness:
Role consciousness refers to an individual performing their assigned role. For example, in a hospital, doctors examine patients and prescribe necessary medicines and treatments.
Nurses administer medicines and care for patients accordingly.
In a school, teachers educate and students learn and face examinations
